body.name: Minimax rate-gap handle
body.construction: First close the estimator-independent bracket \(c b_{nm}\le R^*_{nm}\le C\) on the unchanged predictable class: on the achievability side seek an \(\mathcal O_{n,m}\)-measurable estimator improving \(\widehat U^{\mathrm H}\), and on the converse side use sequential likelihood conditioning to lower-bound every estimator in \(\mathfrak E_{n,m}\).  Only after establishing \(R^*_{nm}\asymp b_{nm}\) should row deletion and local likelihood calculations be used to determine \(C_\star\).
inputs: The hybrid constant-risk upper bound, the constant-propensity packing, and the estimator-specific IPW obstruction.
